hint.feature_title: Freeze Hint Prefer Newest Staged v1
do_not_regress_rules: New Local Freeze Entry must prefer the newest unused staged KANDA_FREEZE_HINT sidecar for current work.
A validated latest hint may only be preserved when the scanned sidecar is the same source or same feature.
Already-frozen or already-used hints must not refill the New Local Freeze Entry form.
Freeze hint intake must not preserve an older validated latest hint forever when a newer current staged hint exists.
Project-specific frozen memory must remain under project_freeze_after_update/frozen_features_memory.
Do not store project-specific frozen memory inside project_freeze_ledger.
Preview Freeze Entry must remain read-only and must not write files.
Confirm and Write must require explicit human confirmation before writing governed freeze memory.
After a local freeze write, the AI startup freeze context must be refreshed.
External AI review remains advanced/fallback, not the normal local freeze path.
